tasks.title: Implement Product and Account Management
tasks.description: Develop features allowing store owners and sales personnel to create and update products and customer accounts.

tasks.title: Implement Catalog Browsing and Shopping Cart
tasks.description: Develop UI for customer product browsing without login and shopping cart management including adding, removing, and quantity updates.

tasks.title: Implement Order Submission Flow
tasks.description: Develop the ordering process requiring user sign-in, order creation, reference display, and empty-cart submission prevention.

acceptance_criteria.given: a store owner or sales personnel is authenticated
acceptance_criteria.then: a new product is added to the system

acceptance_criteria.given: a store owner or sales personnel is authenticated
acceptance_criteria.then: a new customer account is added to the system

acceptance_criteria.given: a customer is visiting the store
acceptance_criteria.then: they are presented with all available products

acceptance_criteria.given: a customer is viewing an available product
acceptance_criteria.when: they add the product to their cart
acceptance_criteria.then: the product is present in the customer cart

acceptance_criteria.given: a customer has items in their cart and is signed in
acceptance_criteria.then: one order containing those specific items and quantities is created

acceptance_criteria.given: a visitor is not signed in
acceptance_criteria.then: they are permitted to browse products

acceptance_criteria.given: a customer is not signed in
acceptance_criteria.when: they attempt to place an order
acceptance_criteria.then: they are prompted to sign in before the order is placed

acceptance_criteria.given: a customer has an item in their cart
acceptance_criteria.when: they update the quantity to a positive whole number
acceptance_criteria.then: the cart quantity is successfully updated

acceptance_criteria.given: a customer has items in their cart
acceptance_criteria.when: they select an item to remove
acceptance_criteria.then: the item is removed from the cart

acceptance_criteria.given: a store owner or sales personnel is authenticated
acceptance_criteria.then: the system reflects the updated product information

acceptance_criteria.given: a store owner or sales personnel is authenticated
acceptance_criteria.when: they update existing customer account details
acceptance_criteria.then: the system reflects the updated account information

acceptance_criteria.given: an order has been successfully submitted
acceptance_criteria.then: a unique order reference is displayed to the customer

acceptance_criteria.given: a customer has an empty cart
acceptance_criteria.when: they attempt to submit the order
acceptance_criteria.then: the submission is rejected and no order is created
